description: Phase C fabric completion (ROADMAP.md Phase C; docs/capability-bus.md §"Not yet built", KCB §5 / KFT §7). Today `auth.grants_required` fixes the grant SHAPE only, and `cost.meter`/`est_units` publish the finetune figure a caller gates on but no ceiling is checked. Enforce grants pinakes-side: verify/rotate presented grants and gate `finetune` admission on a `budget_units` ceiling. CROSS-REPO: issuance/rotation/spend-ceiling policy lives in the orchestrator's workforce governance (the grant ISSUER), so this depends on agora providing that issuer; pinakes implements the ENFORCEMENT seam against koine's KCB contract. Scope: the capability-bus auth/admission path (services/api capability_bus.py, the api-auth successor) + the manifest + tests. Serializes with other Phase-C rows on `capability-bus`.

userStories.title: Enforce presented grants at the capability-bus surface
userStories.description: Verify (and honor rotation of) grants presented against grants_required capabilities, rejecting missing/invalid/expired grants, against grants issued by the orchestrator's grant issuer.
acceptanceCriteria: The capability-bus surface verifies a presented grant against the `auth.grants_required` shape and the orchestrator-issued grant (issuer/rotation honored per KCB §5), rejecting missing/expired/invalid grants with the graded error the contract specifies — implemented against koine's KCB contract, not a re-spec.
The applicable gates pass: `uv run --all-packages pytest services/api/tests`, `uv run --all-packages ruff check services/api`, `uv run --directory services/api --all-packages mypy`.
`bun run check:contracts` passes if the capability-manifest/contract source changed.

userStories.title: Grant-gated budget_units ceiling for finetune
userStories.description: Gate finetune admission on a budget_units ceiling drawn from the grant, so cost.meter/est_units is not just published but enforced (KFT §7).
acceptanceCriteria: Finetune admission checks the request's est_units against the grant's budget_units ceiling and refuses over-ceiling requests, where today only cost.meter/est_units publishes the figure.
A test asserts an over-ceiling finetune request is refused and an under-ceiling one admitted, using a fixture grant (no live orchestrator required for the test).
